root_text: @docrocktex26 My 2-year-old great grandson was diagnosed with Human Metapneumovirus in N. Texas (Wise County) 3 weeks ago. He had to be life flighted to Children's Hospital then intubated as soon as he got there. He was in ICU for 2-3 days.

nodes.text: @docrocktex26 My 2-year-old great grandson was diagnosed with Human Metapneumovirus in N. Texas (Wise County) 3 weeks ago. He had to be life flighted to Children's Hospital then intubated as soon as he got there. He was in ICU for 2-3 days. They have no idea where he got it from.
